question: Under which Five Year Plan in India, the implementation of the Family Planning Programme was amongst the major targets of the Plan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fourth.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Family Planning Programme** was initiated in India in **1952.**
 
• However, it was during the **Fourth Five Year Plan** that the implementation of this programme was given utmost importance.
